questions.q:

Everyone without ______ voted for a holiday
questions.solution:
'C) Exception'का use होगा क्योंकि "exception" का अर्थ होता है किसी नियम, सामान्य स्थिति, या समझौते से छूट। Sentence कहता है कि हर किसी ने छुट्टी के लिए मतदान किया, बिना किसी अपवाद के, जिसका मतलब है कि कोई भी विरोध में नहीं था। 'Omission' का अर्थ होता है छोड़ देना या अनदेखी करना, 'Acceptance' का अर्थ होता है स्वीकृति, और 'Impression' का अर्थ होता है प्रभाव या धारणा, जो इस context में सही नहीं
Exception'should be used because it means a departure from a rule, general condition, or agreement. The sentence implies that everyone voted for a holiday without any exception, meaning there was unanimous agreement. 'Omission' means leaving out or neglecting something, 'Acceptance' means agreement or consent, and 'Impression' means an effect or perception, which do not fit in this context

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
______ repeated warnings, he still comes late.
questions.solution:
A) in spite of'का उपयोग होगा क्योंकि इसका अर्थ होता है किसी चीज़ के बावजूद। Sentence में कहा गया है कि वार्निंग्स के बावजूद वह देर से आता है, इसलिए 'In spite of' यहाँ सही है। 'Even though' भी किसी चीज़ के बावजूद का भाव देता है, लेकिन यह अधिकतर sentence की शुरुआत में या middle में इस्तेमाल होता है, इसलिए इसका इस्तेमाल यहाँ पर सही नहीं है। 'In case of' का अर्थ होता है अगर कुछ होता है तो, और 'In order to' का अर्थ होता है किसी उद्देश्य के लिए, जो दोनों इस context में फिट नहीं बैठते
'In spite of'should be used because it means despite something. The sentence indicates that despite the warnings, he still comes late, making 'In spite of' fitting here. 'Even though' also conveys a similar meaning of despite, but it's more commonly used at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence, thus it's not appropriate here. 'In case of' means if something happens, and 'In order to' means for the purpose of, neither of which fit in this context

questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The prime minister as well as his secretary were expected to(A)/arrive in Chennai(B)/on Saturday morning. (C)/no error(D)
options: The prime minister as well as his secretary were expected to
questions.solution:
A) ‘were’के बदले ‘was’ का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि जब दो subjects ‘as well as’ से जुडते है तो verb पहला subject के अनुसर होता है और प्रश्न में पहला subject ‘The prime minister’ singular है जिसके लिए singular verb का प्रयोग होगा।
A) 'was' will be used instead of 'were' because when two subjects are joined 'as well as' then the verb is according to the first subject and the first subject in the question is 'The prime minister' singular for which Singular verb will be used.

questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The speaker was(A)/not only slow(B)/but also inaudible as well. (C)/no error(D)
questions.solution:
C) ‘as well’का प्रयोग superfluous(अनावश्यक) है और इसे हटाना पडेगा क्योंकि ‘not only’ के साथ ‘but also’ का प्रयोग होता है।
C) The use of 'as well' is superfluous and has to be removed as 'but also' is used with 'not only'.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage some words have been deleted, fill in the blanks with the help ofalternatives given. Select the most appropriate option for each number.
The roots of some plants get swollen with the (1) __________ of storage food which can beused as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are (2)____________ staple foods with (3) __________ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water (4)_____. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
D)'Presence' का use होगा क्योंकि "presence" का अर्थ है किसी वस्तु या तत्व का होना। इस sentence में बताया गया है कि पौधों की जड़ों में भोजन की उपस्थिति से वे सूज जाती हैं, इसलिए 'presence' सही है। जबकि 'existence' का अर्थ है अस्तित्व, 'residence' का अर्थ है निवास, और 'occupancy' का अर्थ है कब्जा या अधिकता, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।
'Presence' will be used because it means the state of being present or existing. In the sentence, it is mentioned that the roots of the plants get swollen due to the presence of stored food, making 'presence' the correct choice. Whereas, 'existence' refers to the state of existing, 'residence' refers to a place of living, and 'occupancy' means the state of being occupied, which don't fit in this context

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage some words have been deleted, fill in the blanks with the help ofalternatives given. Select the most appropriate option for each number.
The roots of some plants get swollen with the (1) __________ of storage food which can beused as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are (2)____________ staple foods with (3) __________ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water (4)_____. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution:
C) 'Nutritious' का use होगा क्योंकि यह शब्द उन खाद्य पदार्थों का वर्णन करता है जो स्वास्थ्य के लिए लाभकारी होते हैं और शरीर को आवश्यक पोषक तत्व प्रदान करते हैं। चूंकि sentence's में उन जड़ों की बात हो रही है जो भोजन के रूप में प्रयोग होती हैं और स्वास्थ्य के लिए महत्वपूर्ण होती हैं, इसलिए 'nutritious' यहाँ सही है। 'Peptic' का अर्थ होता है पाचन संबंधी, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। 'Fattening' का अर्थ है मोटापा बढ़ाने वाला, जो यहाँ फिट नहीं बैठता। 'Unhealthy' का अर्थ है अस्वास्थ्यकर, जो sentence's की भावना के विपरीत है।
'Nutritious'will be used because it describes foods that are beneficial to health and provide essential nutrients to the body. Since the sentence is talking about root crops that are used as food and are important for health, 'nutritious' is the correct choice here. 'Peptic' means related to digestion, which does not fit this context. 'Fattening' means something that causes weight gain, which is not suitable here. 'Unhealthy' means harmful to health, which contradicts the sentence's intention.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage some words have been deleted, fill in the blanks with the help ofalternatives given. Select the most appropriate option for each number.
The roots of some plants get swollen with the (1) __________ of storage food which can beused as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are (2)____________ staple foods with (3) __________ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water (4)_____. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
A) 'energy'का use होगा क्योंकि "energy" का अर्थ होता है शक्ति जो शरीर को कार्य करने के लिए आवश्यक होती है, और यहाँ पर बात हो रही है carbohydrates के द्वारा दी गई ऊर्जा की। 'power' का अर्थ होता है अधिकार या क्षमता, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'capacity' का अर्थ होता है क्षमता, जो भंडारण या किसी कार्य को करने की क्षमता को दर्शाता है, जो यहाँ फिट नहीं होता है। 'Strength' का अर्थ होता है शारीरिक या मानसिक शक्ति, जो इस संदर्भ में carbohydrates से संबंधित नहीं है।
'energy'will be used because it refers to the power that is necessary for the body to function, and here the sentence is discussing the energy provided by carbohydrates. 'power' means authority or ability, which is not suitable in this context. 'capacity' refers to the ability to store or perform a task, which doesn't fit here. 'Strength' refers to physical or mental power, which is not related to carbohydrates in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage some words have been deleted, fill in the blanks with the help ofalternatives given. Select the most appropriate option for each number.
The roots of some plants get swollen with the (1) __________ of storage food which can beused as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are (2)____________ staple foods with (3) __________ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water (4)_____. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
questions.solution:
B)'Content'का use होगा क्योंकि "content" का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज़ में मौजूद पदार्थ या सामग्री। यहां 'large water content' का अर्थ है कि इन फसलों में अधिक मात्रा में पानी पाया जाता है। 'Gain' का अर्थ होता है लाभ, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। 'Utility' का अर्थ होता है उपयोगिता, और 'Worth' का अर्थ होता है मूल्य, लेकिन ये दोनों शब्द भी इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं। इसलिए सही विकल्प 'content' है।
'Content'will be used because it means the amount of substance or material present in something. Here, 'large water content' implies that these crops have a high amount of water. 'Gain' means benefit, which is not fitting in this context. 'Utility' means usefulness, and 'Worth' means value, but neither of these words fit the context either. Therefore, the correct option is 'content'.

In the following passage some words have been deleted, fill in the blanks with the help ofalternatives given. Select the most appropriate option for each number.
The roots of some plants get swollen with the (1) __________ of storage food which can beused as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are (2)____________ staple foods with (3) __________ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water (4)_____. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc.

questions.solution:
D)Examples' का use होगा क्योंकि 'examples' का अर्थ होता है उदाहरण, और यहां पर वाक्य में यह संकेत दिया जा रहा है कि कुछ पौधे जैसे गाजर, चुकंदर, मूली, शलजम, शकरकंद आदि 'root crops' के उदाहरण हैं। जबकि 'illustration' का अर्थ है चित्रण, 'samples' का अर्थ है नमूने, और 'case' का अर्थ है मामला, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं हैं।
'Examples' will be used because it means instances or illustrations of something, and in the sentence, it indicates examples of root crops like carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnips, sweet potatoes, etc. Whereas, 'illustration' refers to a drawing or depiction, 'samples' refers to specimens, and 'case' refers to a specific situation, none of which fit this context.
